description: A serene bedroom with warm greige plaster walls and light oak hardwood flooring. The bed features a tall, button-tufted upholstered headboard in natural linen, dressed with layered cream and oatmeal bedding including a loosely folded linen coverlet and stacked euro pillows. A round side table in dark walnut with antique brass cross-base legs sits beside the bed, holding a tall ceramic vase in creamy white with a bouquet of dried blush flowers, a small stack of two books, and a small dark spherical object. To the far left, a portion of an upholstered chair in warm cream fabric is visible, and in the foreground bottom-left corner a low round coffee table edge is partially in frame. Full-length charcoal drape curtains hang at the left wall, deepening the room's tone on that side. A natural jute rug covers the floor beneath the bed, its coarse texture contrasting with the smooth linen. A warm amber glow falls from a ceiling drop source, pooling over the nightstand vignette and casting soft shadows on the wall. The overall atmosphere is hushed and composed, with a monochromatic sandy palette punctuated only by the soft blush of dried botanicals. Camera is at standing eye-level, shooting with a normal lens at a slightly off-center angle that shows the bed's full headboard and the nightstand together. The composition is a wide vignette capturing approximately two-thirds of the room from the left wall toward the right.
